_comment: Company-wide values for the training content merge fields. Committed on purpose: these are company values, not per-rep values -- if two reps enter two different price ranges, slide 22 teaches two different things at two different kitchen tables. This file is the default and the source of truth; a rep can still override locally for one appointment, and the setup form shows when they have. Empty string = not set yet, which renders as a visible placeholder chip (never raw braces, never blank).
_keys_are: variables[].key from any product's training content file where source == company_settings (data/doghouse-content-v1.json, data/training-content-eclipse.json)
_shared_across_products: This file is loaded once, not per product -- a key set here applies to EVERY product. LEAD_TIME_WEEKS is the live example: the Eclipse rebuild established six to eight weeks for screen projects, but Sunesta's awning lead time is still an open question (oi04 in doghouse-content-v1.json), so this stays empty rather than teaching a screens number at an awning appointment. Per-product company defaults are not supported by the current schema.
